name: HIVA household robot
summary:
HIVA (海娃) is Haier’s humanoid household-service robot, designed to extend smart-home automation to physical chores. Haier describes manipulation from floor level to high household surfaces, including picking up objects and cleaning tasks.

The robot is part of Haier’s wider smart-home strategy and is intended to coordinate physical work with connected appliances. It is distinct from the brand’s separate cleaning and companion robots. The official announcement describes its intended capabilities but does not provide a complete specification sheet or independently verified household-task success
